001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.net.URI;
005
006import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
007import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.format.IPathFormatter;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidTypeFunctionException;
010import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
011import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IItemType;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IKindTest;
014import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
015import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyInstance;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
018
019/**
020 * A Metapath node valued item representing a Metaschema module assembly.
021 */
022public interface IAssemblyNodeItem extends IModelNodeItem<IAssemblyDefinition, IAssemblyInstance> {
023  /**
024   * Get the static type information of the node item.
025   *
026   * @return the item type
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  static IItemType type() {
030    return IItemType.assembly();
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  default IKindTest<IAssemblyNodeItem> getType() {
035    StaticContext staticContext = getStaticContext();
036    return IItemType.assembly(
037        getQName(),
038        getDefinition().getDefinitionQName().toEQName(staticContext),
039        staticContext);
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  default NodeItemKind getNodeItemKind() {
044    return NodeItemKind.ASSEMBLY;
045  }
046
047  @Override
048  default NodeType getNodeType() {
049    return NodeType.ASSEMBLY;
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  default IAssemblyNodeItem getNodeItem() {
054    return this;
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  @Nullable
059  default URI getBaseUri() {
060    INodeItem parent = getParentNodeItem();
061    return parent == null ? null : parent.getBaseUri();
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  default String format(@NonNull IPathFormatter formatter) {
066    return formatter.formatAssembly(this);
067  }
068
069  @Override
070  default IAnyAtomicItem toAtomicItem() {
071    throw new InvalidTypeFunctionException(InvalidTypeFunctionException.DATA_ITEM_IS_FUNCTION, this);
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  default <CONTEXT, RESULT> RESULT accept(@NonNull INodeItemVisitor<CONTEXT, RESULT> visitor, CONTEXT context) {
076    return visitor.visitAssembly(this, context);
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  default boolean deepEquals(ICollectionValue other, DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
081    return other instanceof IAssemblyNodeItem
082        && NodeComparators.compareNodeItem(this, (IAssemblyNodeItem) other, dynamicContext);
083  }
084}
